summary: Demo project 'laser-trigger' created (simulated ESP32-S3 N16R8 on sim://esp32s3-n16r8): 5 of 5 pins ok, 8 parts, 5 solder steps, example firmware copied to firmware/. Next: detect, build and flash on sim://esp32s3-n16r8.

warnings.message: The driving pin sources 2.60 mA. GPIO current limits are not checked here (unverified); see the chip datasheet.
Laser modules can damage eyes. Never look into the beam; keep the output off during boot (pull-down).
C1: Polarised: reverse voltage can open the pressure relief vent (Nichicon). The stripe on the sleeve marks the negative lead (Rubycon). Confirm the polarity before soldering.
Q1 B/C/E follow the symbol only. Take the pinout from the transistor datasheet, do not guess.
